title.zh: 在八打雁省第二区设立若干村落的法案
title.en: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Second District of the Province of Batangas
title.orig: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Second District of the Province of Batangas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2825_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The following sitios in the Municipality of Bauan, Province of Batangas, are constituted as barrios therein to wit:
(a) The sitio of Look is separated from barrio Culbo and the sitio of Look is separated from barrio Magalangalang, and are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio, to be known as the barrio of Bagong Silang; and
(b) The sitios of Tubuhan and San Gelacio are separated from the barrio of Malaking Pook, and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio, to be known as the barrio of Resplandor.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
